items.item_text: Must possess California Driver's license, Class C. Ability to drive a truck or other light vehicle in the course of duties. 100
Background Check: Continued employment is contingent upon the completion of a satisfactory background investigation.
Pre-Placement Physical: Employment is contingent upon the completion of a satisfactory physical examination.
Driving Record: The position is subject to the
California DMV "Pull Notice System"
and continued employment is contingent upon proof of a satisfactory driving record.
High School
Custodial Experience One year previous custodial experience

Join UCLA’s Custodial Services team and help maintain more than 12.5 million square feet of campus facilities. Our dedicated custodians support a wide range of spaces, including laboratories, recreational facilities, vivariums, patient care areas, and more. We’re looking for dependable, service-focused team members committed to providing a clean, safe, and welcoming environment for the UCLA communit y.
Equipment Knowledge of proper use of the various floor care machines utilized by custodial staff, e.g., stripping machine, waxer/buffer, water pick-ups, etc.
Equipment Knowledge of materials, methods, and equipment utilized by custodial staff, including achievement of operational level skills.
Communication Oral communication skills to obtain or convey clear, concise, and grammatically correct information.
Communication Ability to write standard English text at the complete sentence level to write inspection reports, complete forms, and supply orders.
1. Working knowledge of all aspects of custodial cleaning and/or general maintenance duties and services.
2. Ability to coordinate work projects, and direct and inspect the work of subordinates. Also, the ability to lead small groups of individuals to successfully accomplish tasks.
3. Ability to correct inaccuracies in workmanship, and communicate customer concerns to supervision.
4. Ability to maintain highest quality of custodial service at level consistent with University and department standards.
5. Skill in reading technical instructions related to custodial work in order to comprehend equipment operating instructions and/or documents related to the job functions.
6. Oral communication skills to obtain or convey clear, concise, and grammatically correct information.
7. Ability to write standard English text at the complete sentence level to write inspection reports, complete forms, and supply orders.
8. Ability to establish and maintain cooperative working relationships with peers, subordinates, supervisors, administrators, customers, visitors, and outside agencies.
9. Working knowledge of standard safe work practices.
10. Ability to maintain good attendance.
11. Ability to work overtime and weekends.
12. Ability to work various shifts.
